plan.title: Edit Evaluation Time with Buyer Bid Editing Disabled

steps.note: Open the prepared live RFQ with Vendor A's bid; prepared-state cases must start here.
Enable eRFX projects as required by the case.
Use the requested RFQ counter-offer configuration.
Set the buyer bid-edit permission to the disabled state being tested.
Use the requested counter-offer percentage configuration.
Open the Responses view described by the case.
Choose Edit Evaluation Time from the RFQ Settings menu.
Assert that the Edit Evaluation Time window opened.
